name: oneaiworkers
description: A small Cloudflare Worker remote MCP server for LLM-triggered actions.

scripts.test: npm run test:security && npm run test:oauth && npm run test:agents && npm run test:native-gateway && npm run test:neuron-meter && npm run test:release

OAUTH_DB.description: D1 database used by OneAIWorkers to store OAuth, connector registry, connector actions, and audit records. Cloudflare creates it automatically during deployment.

AI.description: Native Cloudflare Workers AI binding used by ai_* tools and data-defined agent teams. No API key is stored in OneAIWorkers.

AGENT_MANAGER.description: SQLite-backed Durable Object namespace that stores agents, teams, queued orchestration runs, progress, budgets, and cancellation state.

MCP_SHARED_SECRET.description: Required. A private password that protects OAuth connection and manual MCP access. Generate a long random value and keep it secret.

CREDENTIALS_MASTER_KEY.description: Required for marketplace connectors. A random Cloudflare Secret used to encrypt connector credentials before they are stored in D1.

CONNECTOR_INSTALLER_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Public ECDSA key used to verify connector installation receipts signed by the official installer.
